# orionbelt_gateway (Data Source)

The gateway's public addresses and SSH certificate authorities.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orionbelt_gateway" "this" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `host_ca_public_key` (String) Trust this to verify the gateway and agents.
- `public_url` (String)
- `ssh_ca_enabled` (Boolean)
- `ssh_host` (String) Host agents and clients dial.
- `ssh_port` (Number)
- `user_ca_public_key` (String) Put in TrustedUserCAKeys on targets that accept gateway-issued certificates.
